settings.meaning: Certificate PIN. Precedence: flag > environment > profile. In a layer, the first available source listed here wins. A literal PIN is accepted only from KIECLI_PIN.
settings.name: pin

settings.meaning: Whether to send the Testmerker. KIECLI_TEST accepts 0 (live) or 1 (test).
